title: College Football
description:
Oregon at Illinois
The Oregon Ducks (4-2) face the Illinois Fighting Illini (3-3) at Gies Memorial Stadium for a Big Ten matchup. Illinois beat Michigan State 38-37 behind Michael Clayton II who scored two TDs. Oregon beat Nebraska 17-14 behind QB Dylan Raiola.
